newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end lower on market correction.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end lower on market correction.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed down when an awaited correction ended a two-week bull-run, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange price index fell 16.54 points or 1.01 percent to 1,605.72 on turnover of 142.5 million taka. Of the 113 issues traded 57 closed lower, 51 ended up and five were unchanged.
National Tubes fell 131.45 taka to 2,299.29, Chittagong Cement lost 110.23 to 3,794.73 and Apex Foods gained 44.20 to 5,748.20.
Brokers said the investors booked profit on mainly engineering, food and textile shares which gained sharply in recent euphoric trading by new investors.
